summary: Completed frontend testing of inline editable narration script, background description, and avatar position features in avatar scene mockups. All features working correctly in Edit Mode (CourseReviewPanel). Create Mode (StoryboardPanel) has the same implementation verified via code review.
critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: AvatarSceneControls.jsx - AvatarSceneMockup component with editable prop, onScriptChange, onBackgroundChange, onPositionChange callbacks
GOOD: Textarea for narration script with character counter (X/1500) that turns red when exceeding limit
GOOD: Input field for background description with 'Cenário de Fundo' label and Cancelar/Salvar buttons
GOOD: Select dropdown for avatar position with Esquerda/Direita/Centro options
GOOD: Editar/Salvar/Restaurar buttons for script editing with proper state management
GOOD: CoursePanels.jsx - handleScriptChange, handleBgChange, handlePositionChange propagating to onScriptOverride
GOOD: Agent.jsx - handleScriptOverride updating selectedImprovements state with narrationScript/backgroundDescription/avatarPosition
GOOD: StoryboardPanel.jsx - slideScriptOverrides, slideBgOverrides, slidePositionOverrides for create mode
GOOD: All data-testid attributes present: edit-script-btn, narration-script-textarea, confirm-script-btn, reset-script-btn, edit-bg-btn, bg-description-input, confirm-bg-btn, avatar-position-select
